info.name: Fathom Analytics REST Account Reports API

params.name: entity_id
params.description: Required when entity is "pageview". The site ID.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Required when entity is "event". The site ID.

params.name: entity_name
params.description: Required when entity is "event". The event name.

params.name: aggregates
params.description: Comma-separated list of aggregate metrics. For pageviews: visits, uniques, pageviews, avg_duration, bounce_rate. For events: conversions, unique_conversions, value.

params.name: field_grouping
params.description: Dimension field to group by. Allowed values: hostname, pathname, referrer_hostname, browser, country_code, city, device_type, operating_system, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term, keyword.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort order in field:asc or field:desc format.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA TZ database timezone name (e.g. America/New_York).

params.name: date_from
params.description: Start of date range as Unix timestamp.

params.name: date_to
params.description: End of date range as Unix timestamp.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: filters
params.description: JSON-encoded array of filter objects with field, operator (is, is not, is like, matching, not matching), and value keys.

items.docs: Returns aggregated analytics data. Rate limited to 10 requests per minute. Supports grouping by time period and dimension fields, sorting, filtering, and timezone-aware date ranges.

params.name: detailed
params.description: If true, returns breakdown by page and referrer.

items.docs: Returns the number of visitors currently on a site. Rate limited to 10 requests per minute.
